name: Kokuryuu Satoru
source:
A college professor who sometimes makes appearances as a pundit on television.
He's intellectual, severe, and always speaks logically. He rarely becomes emotional.
He always expects his son [url=https://vndb.org/c35048]Akatsuki[/url] to do what`s right.
translation:
A college professor who sometimes makes appearances as a pundit on television.
He's intellectual, severe, and always speaks logically. He rarely becomes emotional.
He always expects his son [url=https://vndb.org/c35048]Akatsuki[/url] to do what`s right.
